menu.errorBody: No items are shown until the menu loads. Check the connection and try again.
menu.emptyTitle: No active items for this store
menu.emptyBody: Add categories and active products on the Menu page to sell them here.
menu.noMatchesBody: Try another name or clear the category filter.

ticket.title: Current ticket
ticket.empty: Tap items from the menu to add them to this ticket.

clearDialog.title: Clear this ticket?
clearDialog.body: All items on the current ticket will be removed. Nothing has been charged yet.

modifiers.requiredMissing: Select all required options before adding.

checkout.title: Charge {{amount}}
checkout.insufficient: Amount tendered is less than the total.

receipt.title: Sales receipt
receipt.simulationNote: Demo restaurant. No real payment was processed.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel completed sale
cancelDialog.body: This cancels the recorded order and automatically reverses its stock and cost-of-goods movements.
cancelDialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Customer changed their mind, keying error
cancelDialog.defaultReason: Cancellation requested by the cashier at the register

toast.alreadyCancelled: This sale had already been cancelled.
toast.cancelFailed: The sale could not be cancelled

tax.notConfigured: Sales tax is not configured for this store, so no sale can be recorded here.

errors.tax_rate_changed: The store's sales-tax rate changed while this ticket was open. The ticket was recalculated with the current rate; review the total and charge again.
errors.tax_rate_not_configured: Sales tax is not configured for this store. An owner or store manager must set it before selling.
errors.store_unavailable: This store can no longer record sales: it was deactivated or your access changed. Nothing was charged.

store.chooseTitle: Choose the store for this register
store.chooseBody: Sales are recorded in the store you choose. You can change it later in the location selector.
store.inactiveBody: Inactive stores cannot record sales. Choose an active store to continue.
store.inactiveBodyNoOther: Inactive stores cannot record sales, and none of your other stores is active.
store.notAuthorizedTitle: This store is not available to you
store.notAuthorizedBody: Your access to the selected store has changed. Choose one of your active stores.
store.noneBodyManage: None of your stores is active. Activate or add a store in Locations to start selling.
store.noneBodyAsk: You don’t have access to an active store. Ask the account owner to assign you one.
store.mismatch: This ticket belongs to {{name}}. Charge, hold or clear it to switch to {{target}}.
store.blockedInactive: {{name}} is no longer active, so this ticket can’t be charged. Hold it or clear it.
store.blockedNotAuthorized: You no longer have access to {{name}}, so this ticket can’t be charged. Clear it to continue.
store.heldOnOrgChange: The open ticket was put on hold in {{org}}.
store.holdFailed: This ticket can’t be held for this store.
